paragraphs.text: Crew: a plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gives you a Chief of staff and a crew of specialist agents
# Crew — multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness
**Crew** is an agent orchestrator plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). A **Chief of staff** agent plan
s the work, splits it into tasks, and hands each task to a specialist subagent: Mail, Chat, Code, Re
search, Life or Design. You watch them work live and step in whenever you want.
Nothing irreversible happens without you. Every send, post, purchase, delete, merge or booking waits
for your click on an approval card.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why Crew
Most agent setups give you one agent holding every tool. Crew gives you a team.
- **One planner, many specialists.** The Chief of staff delegates to members scoped to one job, each

with only the tools that job needs.
- **Full visibility.** A kanban board of tasks, a handoff view

of who got what, a map of every tool call, and the reasoning behind each turn.
- **Human in the loop
by design.** Agents propose actions and you approve them. The model never gets a tool that performs

an irreversible action directly.
- **Learns from use.** Rate an answer or correct a member and Crew

proposes a lesson. Approved lessons are added to that member's instructions.
- **Repeatable workflo
ws.** Save a multi-agent run as a workflow, agentic (the lead picks the steps) or fixed (you do), an
lti-agent run as a workflow, agentic (the lead picks the steps) or fixed (you do), and run it again.
## Features
| Surface | What you get |
| **Crew sidebar** | Every member with a face and live status: *idle*, *working* or *needs you*. One

click opens that member's own chat. |
| **Board** | The session's team tasks in four columns. Drag

cards yourself or let the lead move them. |
| **Handoffs** | Which agent got which task, with live s

tate per lane. |
| **Tools** | Each agent's tool access, call counts and last call, with a read-only

call inspector. |
| **Chain of thought** | A card in the chat with each turn's reasoning, tool call

s, timings and sources. |
| **Workflows** | A drag-and-drop builder for agentic and fixed workflows,

with a step-by-step timeline for every run. |
| **Today** | Pending approvals, crew status, a diges

t, this week's calendar and your open pull requests. |
| **Desktop** | The latest screen a computer-

use agent saw, with **Pause** and **Take over**. |
| **Slack** | Mention the crew in Slack. Each mem

ber answers in its own dsh session, and every reply waits for approval. |
| **Roster** | Add, edit a

nd remove members. Each is stored on disk and registered as a dsh agent preset. |
| **Preset gallery
** | Add ready-made members in one click: Analyst, Writer, Editor, Fact-checker, Devil's advocate, T
utor, Markets and Product manager. Adjust any of them before saving; the Chief of staff can call the

m once added. |
| **Own chats** | Each member keeps one chat of its own, in its own folder, so you c

an talk to it without picking a workspace. The Crew tab always takes you back to it. |
| **Live web
and X** | Members with web access search before answering anything time-sensitive, including recent

posts on x.com, and cite each source with its date. |
| **Heavy mode** | For a hard question, or whe
never you say "heavy", the Chief of staff asks two to four teammates the same question in parallel a

nd combines their answers, noting where they disagree. |
| **Your workspaces** | Members with file a
ccess list your workspaces with `crew_workspaces`, read files in any of them and enter one with `wor
king_directory`. Changes outside a member's own folder ask you first. |
## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness with a `web` profile.
Install `dsh-agent-crew` from npm:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Each release on GitHub also carries the package tarballs. To change Crew itself, build it from sourc
ch release on GitHub also carries the package tarballs. To change Crew itself, build it from source.
After installing, restart dsh, open **Plugins** and enable **Crew**.
### Compatibility
Crew is built against dsh `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`. A few parts need core features that stock dsh doesn
't have yet. Crew still installs and runs without them:
| Feature | On a dsh with the feature | On stock dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 |
| Crew sidebar section | Members listed in the left sidebar | Open members from the **Crew** tab in

the right panel |
| A member's own chat | Opens in the member's own folder, ready to type | Opens in

your most recent workspace |
| Member chats in the sidebar | Shown only in the Crew section and tab

| Also listed under **Ungrouped** |
| **Board** tab | Moves Team tasks between columns | Waits for
dsh's agent-team service, which stock dsh doesn't ship |
Everything else (Handoffs, Tools, Chain of thought, Workflows, Today, Desktop, Slack, the roster and
learning) works on stock dsh.
The Design member uses the `web-artifact-designer` skill from `dsh-web-artifact-designer`. Install i
t in the same profile if you want Design:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Optional connections
Crew works without any accounts. Connect them from the Crew tab when you want the matching tools:

- **Google**: Gmail and Calendar, for the Mail and Life members and the Today page.
- **GitHub**: yo

ur open pull requests on the Today page.
- **Slack**: mention the crew from a Slack channel.
Credentials are kept in dsh's credential store, never in plugin files.
## Quick start

1. Click **Chief of staff** in the Crew sidebar section (or the **Crew** tab on stock dsh).
2. Ask f

or something that needs more than one skill:
> Research the three best-rated open-source vector data

bases, compare them in a table, and draft an email to my team with a recommendation.
3. Open the **B

oard** and **Handoffs** tabs to watch the Chief of staff split the work between Research and Mail.
4
. The finished draft appears as an approval card. Nothing is sent until you click **Send**.
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- Each member is a dsh **agent preset** with its own persona, model and tools.
- The Chief of staff

delegates through dsh's subagent and agent-team tools, and only to presets on the crew allowlist.
-
Status is read from each session: an open turn means *working*; an unanswered question or an unclick

ed action card means *needs you*.
- Irreversible actions are action cards whose handler runs only wh

d means *needs you*.
- Irreversible actions are action cards whose handler runs only when you click.
